# Spec card: Mixed review — a seeded, sendable mix of skills from any grades and areas (new page type, PAGE_TYPES 5.5 proposed)

Written by hand from `design/cards/mixed-review/card.json` in the structure `ws-spec-card.mjs` generates (nine sections, the Signed line, the informational §7b). Builders read this card; critics keep reading the full standards and `design/audit/RUBRIC.md`. Keep card.json and this file in step.

A new page type that is a **configuration of the mixed-practice engine, not a second engine**. A pure pool / deal module turns the teacher's filters (grades, areas, only 8/10, unticked skills, from my lessons) and a seed into an explicit list of N items `{categoryId, skillId, opts, seed}`. `buildSheet` lays that list out with `sheet/roles/mixed-practice.js` in review mode (the supports rule of `sheet/roles/review.js`). Every screen host plays the same list. A share code carries the list, the counts, the order, the seed and the size, so the mix is reproduced exactly.

**The deal is executable, not prose (card round 3, root cause of r1 and r2).** `design/cards/mixed-review/proto/dealer-v1.mjs` is DEALER V1: a pure ES module (no DOM, no `window`, no `Math.random`) that turns the pool, the filters, N, the seed, the order, the size (M / L), the week and day and the optional adapt weights into the dealt items, the page split, the shelves and the week. It NEVER measures a page: the split comes from a frozen size × footprint table. `proto/check-v1.mjs` proves every rule of §2, §3 and §7a on pinned fixtures (`node design/cards/mixed-review/proto/check-v1.mjs` → `check-v1: OK (10 props, 29 fixtures)`), and the §3 table is printed by `check-v1.mjs --table`. Where this card and the prototype differ, the prototype is right and the card is the defect. The product dealer is that file moved, unchanged, to `js/modules/mixed-review.js` (§9b step 2).

|---|---|---|

| Supports at review level | `js/modules/sheet/roles/review.js` rule PT-REV-2 (level 1, no steps / models / traces) | read, not changed |

## 1. What it teaches

Retrieval of skills already taught: a short sheet of 5 to 30 problems drawn from the grades and maths areas the teacher ticks, each problem in its own skill's cell at review supports (PT-REV-2), numbered 1..N, scored, with a facsimile answer key and a key summary by area and skill. On screen the same N problems play as a practice card, an online worksheet, a scored quiz and the boss / race games.

**Skills on this page type:** none of its own. Any live skill the filters admit (§7). It adds no skill, no preset, no `SKILL_STANDARDS` / `SKILL_WRM` tag (§9.12). Today the only-8/10 pool is **32 skills** (from `redesign-passed.js`, 2026-11-19): K 4 (OA), 1: 9 (OA 7, NBT 2), 2: 10 (NBT), 3: 4 (NBT 1, OA 3), 4: 1 (NBT), 5: 2 (NBT), M: 2 (Words); areas OA, NBT and Words only — so only-8/10 defaults OFF (§9.6).

**Research.** No premium logins this round (the card writer has no browser). From knowledge of the reference sites: MathWorksheets4Kids mixed / spiral review grade packs (a fixed mix of 10–20 items across strands a page, an answer key); K5 Learning mixed-operations and grade review sheets; IXL recommendations and skill plans (screen-side choice of weak skills, a per-skill score report); Math-Drills mixed sheets with a seeded "new set". Converted to our design: 6–12 problems a page, not 30–50 (12.1); one boxed cell per problem in its own skill's cell; numbers, not letters (PT-MIX-7); the pupil page never names the area (§9.13). **Lane MR-B repeats the research with the logins before it builds** (CLAUDE.md, mandatory).

## 2. Problem types and progression

- No new problem type: each item is its own skill's cell at level 1 (PT-REV-2) with its own instruction in the cell or in its band strip (PT-MIX-4, PT-MIX-5).
- **The mix is DEALER V1** (`proto/dealer-v1.mjs`; each rule names the `check-v1` property that proves it):
  1. **Pool and cycle.** `filterPool(pool, filters)` (§7a; MIXED and NOSTD never enter). A pool under 2 skills is refused with its reason (§9.6). The cycle is `shuffle(rng(deriveSeed('mixed-review-cycle', S)), pool)`; a replayed code uses the code's list in its order (no shuffle); adapt uses a weighted seeded order of the code's listed skills (§7a Weighting).
  2. **Pages from the frozen table, never measured.** `CAP[size][class]`: M compact 12, typical 12, wide 4; L compact 10, typical 8, wide 3 (12.1). A page's capacity C is the smallest CAP of its skills; its count is `pageSize(R, C) = ceil(R / ceil(R / C))` of the R items still to deal (largest page first, the rebalanced last page). Wide skills (number lines, coin rows, base-10 over 100) and flat skills (compact, typical) are dealt on separate pages, then the tail merge (rule 5) may join them. *(prop h: the pages equal the §3 table; no page fills more than one page)*
  3. **Skills a page.** s_p = max(1, min(3, floor(n_p / 2))) *(prop c)*. Skills are chosen fresh first (new to the sheet, and in a week new to the week) while the pool has an unseen skill, then the least used; on a page of one group only. Each page's n_p is split evenly by the real `dealCounts` (interleave.js; equal weights, min 2), the skills with the lowest sheet totals first.
  4. **No skill over ceil(N / 2).** A skill's room is ceil(N / 2) − its total so far; it caps both n_p (the page takes at most its skills' room) and each count (an excess moves to the skill with the most room). *(prop b)* N = 5 → 2 skills (3 + 2); N = 10 at M → 3 skills on one page (4 + 3 + 3).
  5. **Tail merge.** A last page under half full (fill = Σ count / CAP[size][class]) joins the latest earlier page it fits beside: fill ≤ 1, at most 3 skills, at most 7 / 5 shelves. Counts never change. *(props c, h)*
  6. **Exact N.** Exactly N items numbered 1..N, row-major over the pages; the page counts sum to N. *(prop e)*
- **Order** (the teacher's choice; §7a Order modes):
  - `mixed` (default): on a page whose skills are all one class, the M1 arrangement — the items interleaved by the real `interleave` (maxRun 1), rows of k cells; on any other page, GROUPED shelves of one skill whose order is `interleave`d (maxRun 1, seeded `deriveSeed('mixed-review-page', S, day, p)`). Either way **no AVOIDABLE adjacent pair**: the adjacent same-skill pairs equal the fewest the counts allow, max(0, 2·major − T − 1); **a single-skill page is exempt** (its shelves are necessarily side by side: every L all-wide page, §9.17 r2 resolution 1). *(prop d)* The screen plays the printed order.
  - `easyhard`: shelves by placement grade K → 6+, then pick order.
  - `area`: `AREA_ORDER` (CC, OA, NBT, NF, MEAS, DATA, G, RPNS, WORDS), then grade.
- **Supports:** level 1 for every item, as a Review (PT-REV-2): structural scaffolds stay, hint scaffolds, steps, models and traces do not appear. No anchors.

## 3. The drawing

- **Sizes M and L only** (owner 2026-11-13; S dropped: a stored S or an S code reads as M through `offeredSize`). Look **Daily** (mixed-practice `DEFAULT_LOOK`); lattice Auto N = 6 at M, 4 at L. Shelves at most **7 at M, 5 at L** (12.1 Mixed practice). Problems a page at most **12 at M, 10 at L** (12.1 Review 12 / 8–12; DN-1: never over 20 at L), and at most **4 at M, 3 at L** when the page's items are wide visuals (12.1 Wide-visual rows: number lines, base-10 over 100, coin rows). **At most 3 distinct skills a page** (12.1 Review: 2–3 instruction-led sections).
- **Header:** Name · Date · Score ___ / N; two-line tab `Level <grades> | Review` (a week: `Week n | Mon`); title `Mixed review` (HD-13). Footer: the plain CCSS codes of the dealt skills (PT-MIX-7) and, on the teacher footer line, the code and seed.
- **Body:** shelves of one skill each (`SHELF[size][class]` cells: M compact 3, typical 3, wide 1; L compact 4, typical 2, wide 1; a divisor of the Auto lattice), each opening with its band strip (the skill's own instruction, no skill title, no area name), in the order of §2; or, when every dealt skill is one size class, the M1 mixed arrangement (one "Solve." strip, each cell keeps its own instruction). Numbering 1..N row-major across pages. No in-cell skill letter (PT-MIX-7).
- **Key:** the facsimile pages (PT-KEY-1), then the **key summary** (§7a breakdown).

**Capacity / density** — GENERATED by `node design/cards/mixed-review/proto/check-v1.mjs --table` from the frozen `CAP` table of DEALER V1 (A4, full header; a one-class pool). The page split is the dealer's, not the engine's: the engine draws the plan and never re-plans it (L16). Property h asserts the dealer's pages equal this table at M and L for every N, and `fixtures/size-table.json` pins it.

| N | M compact / typical (12) | M wide (4) | L compact (10) | L typical (8) | L wide (3) |
|--:|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 1 (2-up: 5 and 5) | 2 (3 + 2) | 1 (2-up: 5 and 5) | 1 (5) | 2 (3 + 2) |
| 10 | 1 (10) | 3 (4 + 3 + 3) | 1 (10) | 2 (5 + 5) | 4 (3 + 3 + 2 + 2) |
| 15 | 2 (8 + 7) | 4 (4 + 4 + 4 + 3) | 2 (8 + 7) | 2 (8 + 7) | 5 (3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3) |
| 20 | 2 (10 + 10) | 5 (4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4) | 2 (10 + 10) | 3 (7 + 7 + 6) | 7 (3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 2) |
| 25 | 3 (9 + 8 + 8) | 7 (4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 3 + 3 + 3) | 3 (9 + 8 + 8) | 4 (7 + 6 + 6 + 6) | 9 (3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 2 + 2) |
| 30 | 3 (10 + 10 + 10) | 8 (4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 3 + 3) | 3 (10 + 10 + 10) | 4 (8 + 8 + 7 + 7) | 10 (3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3) |

- Skills on a sheet: Σ s_p over its pages when the pool is large enough (a page of 2–3 items holds 1 skill). A pool of mixed classes deals wide pages and flat pages separately, then the tail merge; its pages are each within one page's fill (prop h).
- **A shelf never splits** (PT-MIX-9) and **a skill's last shelf may be short** (r2 resolution 3; prop j: a short shelf is only ever a skill's last, never over k). It is drawn left-aligned: its cells keep their own template width and height, and the row simply ends early — no empty frame, no stretched cell, no blank slot. H13 allows it: H13 measures empty bands INSIDE cells and rows sized for a taller item, and a short shelf has neither (its row is its cells' height).
- **OPEN (H5), not proved by V1 — for the lead.** One-class pools never leave a page under half full (`check-v1.mjs --fill`: 0 of 6,600 compact, 8,100 typical, 19,800 wide pages). Pools that MIX wide and flat skills can: on the 23-skill pool 583 of 10,360 pages (5.6 %) are under half full, every one the sheet's LAST page (a flat remainder after wide pages, e.g. L N = 10: 3 wide + 3 wide + 4 flat at fill 0.45); on a 2-skill pool of one wide and one flat skill 1,514 of 15,000 pages, mostly not last (the ceil(N / 2) room rule shortens the flat pages). H5 reads "a page < 50 % used while its role expects more"; an exact-N sheet's last page expects no more, so V1 treats it as allowed, but this is a reading, not a ruling. Either the lead rules it allowed, or V1 gains a fill-unit planner (wide and flat items on one page by fill) before signing, which changes the §3 table only for mixed pools.
- **When a drawn page cannot hold its dealt cells** (a release whose cell is taller than the table assumed), the engine spills whole shelves to a continuation page and KEEPS the numbering and the deal; it never re-deals (MIX-REVIEW-COUNT `count-spill-redeal`).
- **N = 5 prints 2-up** (§9.7) when the 5 fit a half page (fill ≤ ½: M compact / typical, L compact): the same 5 items twice on one sheet, each half with its own header (Name, Date, Score ___ / 5) and numbered 1–5, a dashed cut line between; the key is 2-up the same way, each half numbered 1–5 (prop e). Otherwise the table's own pages apply.
- Key pages = pupil pages + the summary: under the last key page's grid when its rows fit (rows × 7 mm + 14 mm), else one more key page. A week adds one weekly-table page.

## 4. Rules that apply

### 4a. Core rules — apply every one (15 rules; quoted from `design/cards/rule-index.json`)

**The engine it reuses**

- **PT-MIX-4** (PAGE_TYPES) GROUPED packing. Each skill gets one shelf first; further shelves go to the skill with the largest gap between its target share and its achieved share, while they fit. Each shelf uses its own template's minimum height; spare height is shared equally into the answer zones. Each shelf opens with a band strip (bold skill title plus one instruction). *(This card: no skill title on a review band, §9.13.)*
- **PT-MIX-6** (PAGE_TYPES) Skills are dealt by weighted round-robin; in SHUFFLED, runs of the same skill are 2 or fewer.
- **PT-MIX-7** (PAGE_TYPES) Numbering: GROUPED row-major; SHUFFLED by strip, block, then inside the block. No in-cell skill letter prints (it would read as multiple choice); the skill-to-item map lives on the answer key and the footer lists plain CCSS codes.
- **PT-MIX-9** (PAGE_TYPES) A shelf or strip never splits; too many tall skills spill to page 2 with weights re-solved across both pages.
- **PT-REV-2** (PAGE_TYPES) Supports equal those of the last lesson taught. Steps, models and traces do not appear.
- **PT-CMP-1** (PAGE_TYPES) Any skill can appear on any page role. A role never refuses a skill; the skill's `footprint` decides how many items fit, never whether the skill is allowed. What travels into the role is the configured skill …

**Keys, seeds, sharing, pupil data**

- **PT-KEY-1** (PAGE_TYPES) Every page of every role has a key, for every skill; a page with scored cells can never print without one being available. The key is the identical page rendered with `state: answered`: same geometry, same labels, same pagination. The lint checks that the key's cell count equals the pupil page's.
- **PT-KEY-5** (PAGE_TYPES) Mixed Skill Practice keys add the skill-to-item map and per-skill subtotals under the grid. Daily Spiral and Daily 4 may add one weekly table (slots as rows, days as columns). …
- **PT-DLG-21** (PAGE_TYPES) Form and seed … week and day; seed; "new numbers" — form A, random seed stored with the job — the same seed reprints the same page.
- **PT-DLG-26** (PAGE_TYPES) No option, field or page in this model records, stores or charts a pupil's results. There are no goal pages, trackers, class records, mastery logs, progress graphs or mastery gates. *(The screen weighting of §7a is the NAMED exception **EX-MXR-ADAPT** to this rule and to P-RV-9: screen only, never printed, off on teacher links — §9.2.)*
- **P-RV-9** (PEDAGOGY) "Taught" is read from the Teaching sequence list. With no list, the teacher picks the skills for each panel by hand. No pupil data is involved.
- **P-RV-13** (PEDAGOGY) Pages are coded Week and Day in the footer and seeded from that code, so any day can be reprinted exactly.
- **SCC-P14** (CONTRACT) A page role never invents or overrides a skill's options. It receives the configured skill — the id plus its option values — asks it for cells, and lays them out. …
- **SCC-P16** (CONTRACT) Options must survive sharing and saving. A configured skill's option values travel in the settings segment of the share code … A shared code reopens the same configured skill, not the bare id at its defaults. …
- **DN-1** (DESIGN STANDARD) Reference densities above about 40 responses per page were judged too dense for these pupils; outside fact layouts no page exceeds 20 scored responses at L.

## 5. Owner rulings

1. **2026-11-14** — A new paper type plus a playable mode, MIXED REVIEW: any mix of grades (school placement, chips derived, K–6+); any mix of the 9 areas with CCSS domain labels; optional untick of single skills; "Only 8/10 ✓ skills" ON by default, read from `redesign-passed.js`; 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 problems; a seeded random mix with a "New mix" button; every sheet has an answer key. *(owner, relayed by the lead in the lf-mixreview brief)*
2. **2026-11-14** — Built on the EXISTING mixed-practice engine and the review role. No second engine.
3. **2026-11-14** — SENDABLE: a share code / link reproduces the identical mix; it extends the existing share-code systems, append-only.
4. **2026-11-14** — PLAYABLE: practice card, online worksheet, quiz (scored) and the game modes.
5. **2026-11-14** — All five improvements: (1) a Mon–Fri weekly set; (2) spaced / weak-skill weighting on screen; (3) the key and the results tagged by skill, with a per-domain breakdown; (4) order mixed / easy → hard / by area; (5) a "From my lessons" pool.
6. **2026-11-13** — Screens are print, computer / Chromebook 1280–1366 px and tablet 820–1024 px; no 390 px. Print sizes M and L; S dropped (an S setting or code falls back to M). *(CLAUDE.md fastest-implementation plan, items 7 and 9)*
7. **2026-11-19 (lead)** — The 16 open questions are ruled (§9). Ruling 6 changes ruling 1's default: "Only 8/10 ✓" is OFF while the passed pool is small, with a ✓ on every passed skill and the count on the toggle. Ruling 2 names the weighting exception EX-MXR-ADAPT. Ruling 1: `AREA_LABELS` is built by this lane.
8. **2026-11-19 (lead, card round 3, §1.7)** — Root cause of the two failed card critics: a deterministic deal written in prose on top of an engine that measures layout, with nothing executable to prove it. The deal becomes DEALER V1 (`proto/dealer-v1.mjs`) with its machine check (`proto/check-v1.mjs`); the r2 resolutions are §9 ruling 17.

## 6. Misconceptions

| Id | Error | Wrong |
|---|---|---|
| M-MR1 | Carries the last item's procedure into the next (adds on a subtract item after an add item). The interleave is the point, so each cell's own sign and instruction must be visible in the cell (PT-MIX-5 cue), never only in another skill's band strip. | after 34 + 12 = 46, writes 58 − 23 = 81 |
| M-MR2 | Reads difficulty from position (easy → hard) and stops at the first hard one. The default order is mixed; easy → hard is the teacher's choice. | leaves items 7–10 blank |
| M-MR3 | (teacher) Reads one total as mastery. The key summary and the results split the score by area and skill, so a 7 / 10 that is 4 / 4 place value and 0 / 3 time shows as that. | "7 / 10, fine" |

## 7. Options and presets

The options belong to the **page type** (job / section scope, PAGE_TYPES 9), not to any skill. Each dealt skill keeps its own options (SCC-P14): its defaults, or its preset skill's values. No preset skill is added (§9.12).

### 7a. Hosts, roles and options — the decisions (signed)

**Options (the teacher's Mixed review panel)**

| Option | Values | Default | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grades` | chips K, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6+ (multi) and All | the Skills screen's grade selection (`mq_teacher_skills_ui`), else Grade 2 | **offered** — a skill's chips = its **school placement** (the school grades whose pacing lessons link it: `allLessons()` of `wrm-links.js` (rows with `grade`, `seq`, `weeks`) → step → curated `direct` skills + `SKILL_WRM`) ∪ its `data.js` grade; 6+ = grade 6; M skills §9.5; each chip shows its pool count; a 0 chip shows greyed with its count |
| `areas` | 9 chips: CC, OA, NBT, NF, MEAS, DATA, G, RPNS, WORDS | all on | **offered** — from `areaOf`; each chip labelled from `AREA_LABELS` (table below, built by this lane, §9.1); MIXED and NOSTD skills are never in the pool |
| `onlyPassed` | on / off | **off** (while the passed pool is small; §9.6) | **offered** — the toggle stays visible with its live count, "Only 8/10 ✓ (32)" = the filtered pool ∩ `REDESIGN_PASSED`; every passed skill in the picker shows a ✓ beside its name whatever the toggle; on = the id is in `REDESIGN_PASSED`, read live |
| `skills` (untick) | one tick per pool skill | all ticked | **offered** — stored as the unticked ids, so a skill that joins the pool later arrives ticked |

**Page roles (buildSheet)**

- `role:mixed-review` — **offered** — NEW: a `ROLE_ALIASES` entry to `mixed-practice` with `input.review = {total: N, order, title: 'Mixed review', tab: 'Review', supports: 1, fill: false}` (§9.3).
- `role:answer-key` — **offered** — the facsimile key of every sheet + the key summary and the weekly table (PT-KEY-1, PT-KEY-5, PT-KEY-7).
- `role:mixed-practice` — **out of scope** — the engine this page type configures; its own page is graded by its own lane (mixed-m1 / mixed-pages).
- `role:review` — **out of scope** — its rule PT-REV-2 is read; its lesson page (2.8) is not a mixed review.
- every other role (independent, more-practice, opener, scripted-model, guided, error-analysis, test, pre-skill-check, word-problems, fact-rows, fact-probe, true-false, reason-it, stretch, lesson, detailed-lesson) — **out of scope** — single-skill and lesson roles; a mixed review never uses them.

**Screen hosts**

- `host:print` — **offered** — pupil pages + key at M and L, A4 and Letter.
- `host:practice-card` — **offered** — the items one at a time, at 1280–1366 and 820–1024.
- `host:online-worksheet` — **offered** — the N items as one sheet, scored on Check, breakdown on the score card.
- `host:quiz` — **offered** — built from the mix ("Make a quiz", existing `?quiz=` share, §9.10), scored out of N, results by area and skill.
- `host:boss`, `host:race` — **offered** — the owner's "game modes": the same item list in the printed order; **the game ends at item N and is scored out of N** (the boss / race timers keep running for the animation only; when the opponent would finish first, the game still waits for item N; no item repeats or cycles) (r2 resolution 8); graded by MIX-REVIEW-HOSTS and `ws-chromebook-fit`, not by the visual critic.
- `host:mode-dark`, `host:mode-bigboard` — **out of scope** — display modes of the same card, graded by `ws-chromebook-fit` / `ws-screen-slots` as on every card.
- `host:map` — **out of scope** — the MAP screen does not host mixed review.
- width 390 — **hidden** — no phone width (owner 2026-11-13). Answer boxes keep 48 px touch targets at 820.

**Share code** (the Direct Play link / enhanced skill code, `?c=<skills>|<tokens>`, `skill-codes.js` `generateEnhancedSkillCode` / `parseEnhancedSkillCode`)

```
?c=AO4-AQ3-AK3|V1-N10-S93CI-Zm                       one sheet, order mixed, size M (pinned: pool-large, S = 424242)
?c=AO4-AQ3-AK7-AN4-…-AA3|V1-N10-S93CI-Oa-Y12-Zm       a Mon-Fri week, week 12, by area (the week's skills with week totals)
?c=<same>|V1-N10-S93CI-Oa-Y12-K3-Zm                   Wednesday of that week
```

- **Skills part:** the DEALT list in the dealer's pick order (`out.dealt`), each the frozen 2-char code + its item count written as the existing weight digits + its `~option` suffix (a single sheet: its counts; a week: the week totals). Decoding replays the list as the pool, in that order, with no shuffle (`replayInput`); the counts are then asserted against the re-deal, never trusted blindly (prop a).
- **New tokens (appended):** `V1` mixed review, dealer V1 · `S<base36>` the seed · `O<e|a>` order easy → hard / by area (absent = mixed) · `Y<week>` a Mon–Fri week (absent = one sheet) · `K<1–5>` one day of a week code · `P1` adapt to each pupil on screen (absent = off) · **`Z<m|l>` the print size** (r2 N2; Z is free; a V1 code without Z is refused, an `s` reads as m). Reused: `N<n>` count, `G<p|b|r|w>` host, `H`, `T` as today. Letters already taken: T N G R D A Q H W F X.
- **Why Z:** the page split, the shelves, the M1 rows and so the printed number order depend on the size, through the frozen `CAP` / `SHELF` tables (not through CSS). With Z the code fixes them; every host plays the list in that order whatever the device (prop a FAIL `fail-a-no-size-token`).
- **Compatibility:** append-only. No frozen code, position or token meaning changes; a code with none of the new tokens decodes byte-for-byte as before (`ws-code-snapshot`, `ws-share-options`). An OLD app skips V / S / O / Y / K / P / Z (its `switch` ignores unknown keys) and plays the same skills with the same weights as an ordinary mixed set: the skills survive, the identical items do not. This is stated in the Copy-link panel, not hidden.
- **V1 is a file, frozen by its sha.** `V1` means "dealt by `dealer-v1.mjs` whose sha256 is pinned in `proto/fixtures/frozen.json`" (prop i). The file moves to `js/modules/mixed-review.js` unchanged (the pin moves with it); any change to what it deals — the cycle, the table, the page split, the tail merge, the shelf order, the week rotation — ships as `V2` in a new file, and the V1 file stays so every V1 code keeps rebuilding the same sheets and days. A week or day code re-runs the frozen week from its skills part; the round trip of every day code is prop a. (Encoding each day's list in the code was rejected: the skills part's `-` grammar has no day separator an old decoder would skip safely.)
- **Identical — one dealer.** The product's `dealReviewItems(req)` (in `print-sheet.js`, beside the duplicate ladder it must run: `RETRIES` = 40 and the rungs unique / answers / turn / repeat) takes the decoded request, calls V1's `deal` / `week` for the PLAN (skills, counts, pages, shelves, numbers, item seeds), and runs each item through `generateQuestionFor` with try r of item i = `deriveSeed('mixed-review', S, day, i, r)` (V1 gives r = 0: `deriveSeed('mixed-review', S, day, i)`), accepting the first try the ladder passes. It returns the ACCEPTED list `[{categoryId, skillId, opts, seed, q}]` in printed order. `buildSheet` lays out exactly that plan (no measuring decides a page), and every screen host plays exactly that list — none calls `generateQuestionFor` itself — so print and screen match by construction, retries included. Same code + same release ⇒ byte-identical items. A later release that changes a generator may change numbers; the skills, counts, pages, order and seed never change under V1.
- **Adapt (`P1`).** The pupil's device deals from **the code's listed skills only** (prop g): the weights order the seeded choice among them, the counts are the normal deal. Identical per device, not across pupils.

**Weekly set**

- Five sheets Mon–Fri of N problems each. Day d seed = `deriveSeed('mixed-review-week', S, d)`.
- Rotation (DEALER V1 `week`, frozen with the file): one cycle for the week (`deriveSeed('mixed-review-cycle', S)`); each day deals its sheet with the choice order fresh (unseen this week) → not on yesterday's sheet → least used this sheet → least used this week → pick order. So **every pool skill appears before any repeat other than the planned comeback** (r2 resolution 4), and **no skill falls on two consecutive days** while |pool| ≥ 2·k_d (prop f). **The comeback:** from Wednesday, the first page of day d opens with the first skill of day d − 2 that is not on day d − 1 (spacing). Prop f exempts exactly that skill on that day.
- Print: 5 pupil sheets (tab `Week n | Mon` … `Fri`, footer code with K1–K5), then 5 keys, then one weekly key table (PT-KEY-5: areas and skills as rows, Mon–Fri as columns, item numbers in the cells). Each day reprints exactly from its day code (P-RV-13). The week reuses its one plan for each day; a day code rebuilds that same day, never re-plans it differently (L24).

**Weighting** (screen only, `adapt` on) — **EX-MXR-ADAPT, the named screen-only exception to PT-DLG-26 / P-RV-9** (owner request 2026-11-14; §9.2): never printed, never sent, never a teacher record, off on teacher links unless "Adapt to each pupil" (`P1`).

- w(skill) = 1 + due + weak. due = 1 when `state.spacedRepetition[skillId].nextReview` ≤ today (+1 more at Leitner box 1 or 2); weak = 1 when `state.skillProgress[skillId].total` ≥ 5 and `mastery` < 70; a skill with no record has w = 1; w ∈ 1..4.
- **The pool is the code's listed skills only** (r2 resolution 7): adapt never reads the filters or the full pool. w orders the seeded choice among them (V1 `weightedOrder`, keys u^(1/w)); the per-skill counts are the §2 deal unchanged (even on each page, at most ceil(N / 2)); w never reaches `dealCounts` (prop g: `fail-g-full-pool`, `fail-g-weighted-counts`).
- **A pupil-started mix** (the pupil's own "Mixed review" button) has no picker: it starts from the last teacher code opened on that device — its listed skills, N, order and size, i.e. the teacher-set filters as the teacher dealt them, carried in the code — with adapt on. With no saved teacher code the button is not offered.
- Read once at start (a snapshot): the session's list is fixed. Results go back through the `updateSkillProgress` / `updateSpacedRepetition` path every host already calls. Never on print, never sent, never a teacher record (EX-MXR-ADAPT, §9.2). Keyed by bare `skillId`, as `progress.js` keys it today.

**Breakdown layout** (key and results)

- **Key summary** (teacher page; Andika, black and white; 11 / 12 pt at M / L): columns **Area** (name + CCSS domain code) | **Skill** (label) | **Items** (numbers) | **Score ___ / n**; one subtotal row per area `___ / n_area`, in `AREA_ORDER`; a total row `___ / N`. Under the last key page's grid when its rows fit, else its own key page. Built from `skillItemMap(plan)` + `areaOf`.
- **Results** (online-worksheet score card, quiz results, the game end screen): "By area" rows (area name + icon; screen chrome may use the area colour, PT-SCR-1) with correct / total and the item numbers, each opening to its skills, weakest first. The quiz results extend the existing `skillAnalysis` (quiz-results.js) with the area grouping; the game end screen reads `game-flow.js`'s `skillBreakdown`.
- Per-skill and per-area subtotals always sum to N.

**Order modes**

- `mixed`: V1 §2 Order — the M1 item interleave on a one-class page, seeded shelf order otherwise; no avoidable adjacent pair, a single-skill page exempt (prop d). The M2 block packer is not needed (§9.4). There is no separate screen order: the hosts play the printed order.
- `easyhard`: shelves by placement grade, then pick order (on each page).
- `area`: `AREA_ORDER`, then placement grade (on each page).
- Numbering 1..N row-major on paper; every screen host plays the items in the printed number order, so item 7 is the same problem everywhere.

**Lessons pool** (`fromLessons` on)

- For each ticked grade g: the lessons of g's school sequence (`allLessons()` from `wrm-links.js`, the rows with `grade` = g, `seq` and `weeks`; `unitLessons(g, unit)` for the `unit` window) whose week lies in the window ending at `weekForDate(g, today)` → their WRM steps → the skills listed `direct` for those steps in `data/curriculum/links/<YEAR>.json`, plus `skillsForWrmStep(step)` (`SKILL_WRM`).
- Then the area, only-8/10 and untick filters apply as usual.
- Outside the school year (no week): `year` = the whole sequence; `unit` / `4w` say "No school week today" and fall back to `year`.
- No pupil data and no teacher records (P-RV-9).

Browser: the MEASURED rendered pupil pages equal V1's plan — the same pages, the same cells on each, the same numbers 1..N (2-up N = 5: two identical halves of 5 cells, each numbered 1..5, Score /5); Score denominator N; the key has the same cells in the same places (PT-KEY-1) plus the summary. | b, c, d, e, h, j | count ≠ N → `count-ignored` (proto `fail-e-ignores-n`) · a page over one page's fill or over 7 / 5 shelves → `count-over-ceiling` (proto `fail-h-cap-changed`) · 4 skills a page → `count-4-skills` (proto `fail-c-four-skills`) · a skill over ceil(N / 2) → `count-over-half` (proto `fail-b-no-ceiling`) · an avoidable adjacent pair → `count-adjacent` (proto `fail-d-grouped-adjacent`) · a short shelf that is not a skill's last → `count-short-shelf` (proto `fail-j-short-first`) · N = 5 one short page when the 5 fit a half → `count-2up` (proto `fail-e-no-2up`) · a 2-up half not numbered 1..5 → `count-2up-numbers` · a drawn page that cannot hold its cells and is re-dealt, not spilled by whole shelves with its numbers kept → `count-spill-redeal` · a key whose cells differ → `count-key-cells` |

## 9. Rulings (lead, 2026-11-19)

The lead ruled on the 16 open questions on 2026-11-19 (via the coordinator). Each question is kept with its ruling.

1. **AREA_LABELS is not in the repo (lf-checks has not added it; teacher-areas.js has AREA_ORDER / AREAS with 8 maths areas + MIXED, WORDS, NOSTD). Which are the 9 areas and their CCSS domain labels?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): AREA_LABELS is ours to build: a new export of js/modules/teacher-areas.js with the exact labels of the lessons-browser card (card areaLabels); build-plan step 1b. The 9 pool areas are the 8 maths areas + WORDS; MIXED and NOSTD never in the pool. lf-checks reuses ours.
2. **Weak-skill weighting reads the pupil's own progress, which PT-DLG-26 and P-RV-9 forbid for pages. Allow it on screen?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): The weak-skill weighting is the NAMED screen-only exception EX-MXR-ADAPT to PT-DLG-26 / P-RV-9, because the owner asked for it: the pupil's own device record, a start-of-session snapshot, never printed, never sent, never a teacher record, off on teacher links unless 'Adapt to each pupil' (P1). Named in PT-MXR-9 and in the PT-DLG-26 / P-RV-9 amendment sentences.
3. **Role id: a ROLE_ALIASES entry mixed-review -> mixed-practice with input.review, or a thin roles/mixed-review.js wrapper?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): Role id: a ROLE_ALIASES entry mixed-review -> mixed-practice with input.review (title, tab, supports level 1, exact total, order, fill off); no new module.
4. **Order 'mixed' when the dealt skills have different size classes (the usual case across grades and areas): the M2 2 x 2 block packer is not built.** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): Order mixed across size classes: a shelf-level interleave (each shelf one skill with its band strip, shelf order seeded, no two shelves of one skill adjacent); the M1 interleaved shelves for one size class; M2 later, no format change.
5. **Grade 'M' (Mixed levels) skills, e.g. the two vocabulary skills, and the 6+ chip: where do they sit?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): Grade M skills sit under every chip their school placement lists, else under every ticked chip (counted once). 6+ = grade 6 skills.
6. **The only-8/10 pool is small: 32 skills, all OA / NBT / Words (grade 4: 1 skill, grade 6+: none). With the default ON most area chips are empty.** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): 'Only 8/10 ✓ skills' defaults OFF while the passed pool is small. Every passed skill shows a ✓ in the picker; the toggle stays visible with its count, e.g. 'Only 8/10 ✓ (32)'. A pool under 2 skills is refused with its reason; never widened silently.
7. **N = 5 is a short page (about 40 % at L): H5 says a page under half used is wasted.** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead; wording corrected after card critic r1, D12): N = 5 prints 2-up when the 5 items fit a half page (M typical / compact, L compact): the same 5 items twice on one sheet with a dashed cut line, each half with its own header, numbered 1–5 and scored /5, the key 2-up the same way. Otherwise the §3 table's pages apply.
8. **Per-skill options inside a mix (a teacher who wants mult_facts 7s and 8s only).** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): Per-skill options in v1: each skill at its defaults or its preset's values; the code already carries ~opts.
9. **Week sharing: one week link with a day picker, or five day links?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): Week sharing: one week link (Y) that opens a day picker; the Copy menu also gives each day's link (K).
10. **Quiz host: a new G letter, or the existing quiz builder and ?quiz= share?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): Quiz host: 'Make a quiz' builds a one-section quiz of the mix's N items (each tagged with its skill), shared with the existing ?quiz=; no new G letter.
11. **From my lessons: the default window when the teacher turns it on, and is the school pacing the right source (not the teacher's own plan)?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): From my lessons: default window '4w' when turned on; source = the school pacing (P-RV-9).
12. **Does the owner rule 'a distinct option is also a findable skill' apply?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): No preset skill and no new tags: mixed review is a page type, findable as 'mixed review', 'spiral review', 'review sheet' in the print picker.
13. **Should the pupil page name the area (band titles 'Place value', 'Time')?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): The pupil page never names the area: instruction strips only; the key summary, footer CCSS codes and results name them.
14. **May the teacher turn the key off?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): The key print may be unticked (default on); it is always built, previewed and reachable from the code (PT-KEY-1).
15. **Defaults: 10 problems, order mixed, size = the teacher's print default (L when unset), week off, fromLessons off?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): Defaults: 10 problems, order mixed, size = the teacher's print default (L when unset), week off, from my lessons off, only 8/10 off.
16. **Signing: ws-spec-card has no page-type kind, so this card has no machine block and --check-signed cannot verify it.** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead): The card stays hand-written (kind page-type) and is signed by hand; lane MR-E may later add a page-type kind to ws-spec-card and regenerate it.

17. **Card critic r2 (FAIL, min 6): how are its findings resolved?** Ruling (2026-11-19, lead, card round 3): (1) a single-skill wide page is exempt from adjacency; (2) the deal is a pure dealer with a frozen size × footprint page table and a `Z<m|l>` size token; (3) a skill's short last shelf is allowed (H13 measures inside cells); (4) the comeback is exempt from "before any repeat"; (5) the `AREA_LABELS` assert: no other file holds the WHOLE label map; (6) one named fixture per FAIL state for every check; (7) adapt samples only the code's listed skills, and a pupil-started mix uses the teacher-set filters carried in the code; (8) boss and race end at N, scored out of N; (9) cite `allLessons()`, not LESSONS.

+  its cells at their own size. A drawn page that cannot hold its cells spills whole shelves and keeps its numbers. N = 5
+  prints 2-up when the 5 fit a half page: the same 5 items twice, a dashed cut line, each half with its header, numbered
+  1 to 5 and scored /5, the key 2-up alike; otherwise the pages of the table below.
+- **PT-MXR-4. Order.** Mixed (default): no avoidable pair of one skill side by side (shelves, or items in the M1
+  arrangement of a one-class page); a single-skill page is exempt. The screen plays the printed order.
+  Easy to hard: placement grade, then teaching order. By area: AREA_ORDER, then easy to hard. The pupil page never names
+  the area.
+- **PT-MXR-5. Supports** are those of a Review (PT-REV-2): level 1, no steps, models, traces or anchors. Each skill keeps
+  its own options (SCC-P14).
+- **PT-MXR-6. Seed and code.** The seed, the dealt list with its counts, the order, N and the size travel in the share
+  code (`V1`, `S`, `O`, `N`, `Z`; a week `Y`, a day `K`), appended to the enhanced skill code; the same code and release
+  reprint and replay the identical mix on every host. V1 is the dealer file pinned by its sha256: a change ships as V2.
+  Old codes decode unchanged.
+- **PT-MXR-7. Week.** A Mon-Fri set is five sheets of N, each seeded from (seed, day); every pool skill appears before
+  any repeat other than the planned comeback, no skill on two consecutive days when the pool allows, and from Wednesday
+  one comeback a day from two days before.
+- **PT-MXR-8. Key.** Every sheet has the facsimile key (PT-KEY-1) and a key summary: Area | Skill | Items | Score per
+  skill, a subtotal per area in AREA_ORDER, a total /N (PT-KEY-5). A week adds one weekly table.
+- **PT-MXR-9. Screen.** The same N items, in the printed order, play as the practice card, the online worksheet, a quiz
+  built from the mix (scored /N) and the boss and race games. Results show the score by area, each opening to its
+  skills. The boss and race games end at item N and are scored out of N. **EX-MXR-ADAPT** (the named screen-only
+  exception to PT-DLG-26 and P-RV-9, owner request 2026-11-14): "Adapt to each pupil" weights due and weak skills from
+  the pupil's own record on that device, choosing only among the code's listed skills; it is never printed, never sent,
+  never a teacher record, and is off on a teacher's link unless the teacher ticks it.
+

## 7b. What the repo offers today (informational, not signed)

Read by hand from the repo on 2026-11-19 (master d3830882). Not part of the signed card.

**Page roles (`print-sheet.js` SHEET_ROLES + `sheet/roles/index.js` ROLE_MODULES / ROLE_ALIASES):** independent, more-practice, opener (lesson-opener), scripted-model (model), guided, error-analysis (check-it), review, test (test-a, test-b), pre-skill-check (pre-skill), word-problems, fact-rows, fact-probe, mixed-practice (mixed), true-false, reason-it (reason), stretch, lesson; answer-key is the companion of all. No `mixed-review` yet. The teacher picker (`teacher-print.js` PAGE_TYPES) lists "Mixed review: Mixed practice · Daily 4 · Daily spiral · Today's Number"; only Mixed practice is WORKING.

**Mixed practice today:** GROUPED shelves (PT-MIX-4) and the M1 mixed arrangement for one size class (`mixedClass`, `interleave`, `dealCounts` min 2); the count FILLS the page (`total = shelves × k`), with `fill` off (`F0`) for a short page; the M2 block packer for mixed size classes is not built.

**Screen hosts the screen gates drive:** practice-card, online-worksheet, quiz, boss, race, map, mode-dark, mode-bigboard.

**Share-code settings tokens in use** (`generateEnhancedSkillCode`): T timer, N count, G mode (p b r w), R range, D decimals, A adaptive, Q Quick Start lock, H help, W arrangement (m p), F fill, X related facts. Skill parts: 2-char code + weight digits + `~options`.

**Pool sources:** `REDESIGN_PASSED` 32 ids (2026-11-19); `teacher-areas.js` `AREA_ORDER` (CC OA NBT NF MEAS DATA G RPNS MIXED WORDS NOSTD) — no `AREA_LABELS`; school pacing in `wrm-links.js` (`allLessons()`, `unitLessons()`, `schoolWeeksOf`, `weekForDate`), grades PK–5 (WRM R, Y1–Y6); progress `state.skillProgress` and `state.spacedRepetition` keyed by bare skill id.

**Results today:** `quiz-results.js` groups by skill (`skillAnalysis`, weakest first); `game-flow.js` saves `skillBreakdown` per session; `answer-key.js` has `skillItemMap` and `answerListRows`. No area grouping anywhere yet.
